reportingFollowup.scope: Current disposition for every saved item. The preparation dataset owns draft text, original citations, destinations and bounded duplicate evidence. Receipt IDs below resolve within this file; no receipt is copied into the preparation dataset.

statusMeaning.prepared-tracker: Qualified draft exists; the official tracker workflow remains unsent. Select its actual component where needed and resolve form/access requirements before one send. The source-comment challenge was not independently tested on every feature form.
statusMeaning.blocked-human-verification: The source comment is filled in its existing thread, with Comment disabled behind manual human verification. No Comment action was dispatched.
statusMeaning.held-existing-restricted: The requested outcome is already covered by a matching thread with restricted commenting. Do not refile the same request.
statusMeaning.held-evidence: The stated reachability or intended-behavior question remains unresolved; no outgoing defect claim is ready.
statusMeaning.existing-upstream: Retain the canonical report and original attribution; no new report or useful new reproduction is established.
statusMeaning.submitted: A new project-authored owner issue, comment or discussion has a separately verified public receipt below.
statusMeaning.sent-email: The reviewed message was sent once and separately read back in Sent. Recipient acceptance and a public receipt remain unknown.
statusMeaning.feedback-upload-verified: One native product-feedback invocation and its correlated HTTP 204 upload are verified. No tracker permalink or human-triage receipt is established; do not resend.
statusMeaning.superseded: Current platform/optional-collection qualifications supersede the earlier reporting premise; actual collection remains unmeasured.
statusMeaning.source-correction-retained: The research already uses the migrated canonical source; no additional owner report is justified.

limitations: Creating this file, a local draft, a GitHub issue, or opening the Google form is not a Google submission.
No existing upstream issue is counted as this project's newly submitted report.
No prediction of Google acceptance, prioritization or implementation is made.

publication.interpretation: Receipt status records successful publication to the named channel. Open and closed describe the independently tracked GitHub items; neither implies upstream acceptance.
